a.xlink:title: Creates an ensemble: the global domain and its MPI topology.
Builds the MPI topology of a domain, once, so no hot path calls an MPI topology function again.
calloc that aborts instead of returning NULL.
Destroys an ensemble, its domain and every object it owns. Safe on NULL.
malloc that aborts instead of returning NULL.
Releases the persistent communication workspace of an ensemble.
Frees an object (two pool blocks and the struct) and NULLs the caller's pointer. Safe on NULL.
Releases the allocation and returns the buffer to its initial state.
Releases the arrays indexed by destination rank, including the heap each per-destination buffer owns.
